articles.title: LG Kavinder inaugurates Parallel Taxi Track Project worth approx Rs 452 cr at Air Force Station Leh
articles.summary: Lieutenant Governor Kavinder Gupta inaugurated the Parallel Taxi Track Project at Air Force Station Leh. This crucial infrastructure development significantly bolsters the Indian Air Force's operational capabilities in the strategically vital Ladakh region. The project enhances aircraft movement efficiency, ensures rapid deployment, and strengthens India's overall defence preparedness, vital for national security in the northern frontiers.

articles.title: Delhi High Court issues notice to DGCA on delay in pilot rest rules
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court has issued notice to the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) regarding a petition. This challenges the aviation regulator's decision to keep certain implementations in abeyance. The High Court's action mandates the DGCA to respond, signifying a judicial review of regulatory actions impacting the national aviation sector and ensuring accountability in policy enforcement.

articles.title: India goes Intercontinental with landmark EU trade deal
articles.summary: India's exports, accounting for 22% of its GDP, are vital for boosting domestic incomes and creating employment. The nation is strategically pursuing trade agreements to enhance these exports. articles.title: Dr Madhu Chopra shares throwback picture with late husband serving in the Indian Army; says, ‘These years shaped the way we raised Priyanka and Siddharth’
articles.summary: Dr Madhu Chopra recently shared a poignant throwback picture on social media featuring her late husband, Dr Ashok Chopra, from their service days. Both served as "uniform-serving" doctors in the Indian Army, highlighting their dedication to the nation through military healthcare. The post offers a glimpse into their early careers and shared commitment, serving as a memorable tribute to their time in uniform.

articles.title: Rusted mortar shell destroyed in Poonch
articles.summary: A rusted mortar shell was discovered in a village near the Line of Control (LoC) in Poonch district, Jammu and Kashmir. Security officials successfully diffused the ordnance through a controlled explosion on Wednesday. Such recoveries are common in border regions, highlighting the ongoing security challenges and the importance of vigilance and proper disposal of unexploded ammunition to ensure civilian safety.

articles.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Thursday
articles.summary: Indian markets, Sensex and Nifty, ended higher Wednesday, driven by a landmark trade agreement between India and the European Union. This significant pact boosted investor confidence and risk appetite, extending previous gains. The agreement signals stronger economic ties and potential growth for India, crucial for understanding its global economic standing and current affairs.
